subject: Retention & deletion flight plan — request for log-exception and purge timeline
messages:
From: Anders Holm <anders.holm@terrahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention ask for EU pilot — backups and logs

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. Two asks from Legal/Compliance while we finalize the DPA addendum for the pilot:

1) We need a clear backup purge timeline and an operational description of the deletion workflow — specifically how long backups are retained after a user deletion request and what the restore/rollback window is.
2) TerraHealth requires a temporary log-retention exception for a narrow set of audit logs (auth, admin, and data-change events) to 365 days for the pilot cohort. Please confirm whether Redwood can:
   - provide immutable snapshots or escrowed logs for the 365-day window, and
   - produce sample audit-evidence showing the schema and retention markers.

Can you respond with a short flight plan (timeline + owners) and any dependencies (procurement, legal sign-off, subprocessor notice)?

Appreciate it — Anders
Legal / TerraHealth

[Attachment: none]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Anders Holm <anders.holm@terrahealth.com>, TerraHealth Legal <legal@terrahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention ask for EU pilot — backups and logs

Anders — thanks, sending a concise plan below. Attaching a proposed flight plan spreadsheet for ops/procurement to review.

Summary (high level):
- Standard behavior: user-data deletions trigger immediate logical delete, primary store purge window = 30 days (soft-delete), followed by background irreversible purge job that clears primary stores and indexes. Backups (snapshots) are on a 7-day cadence and retained for 90 days by default. Audit logs are retained in hot storage for 90 days and archived to cold storage thereafter.

TerraHealth pilot exception (proposed):
- Backup purge timeline: delay purge of affected snapshots by 275 days (so total snapshot retention for pilot = 365 days). Purge action is flagged and gated by Legal/Procurement sign-off.
- Deletion/restore window: We will keep a 30-day soft-delete for primary + an additional 335 days of snapshot availability (combined = 365-day reachable retention). Restore requests during that window require a documented ticket and approval (owner: Marissa Cole — Ops).
- Log retention exception: For the pilot-scoped audit categories (auth/admin/data-change) Redwood can provide immutable archived logs for 365 days. Implementation: generate WORM-style snapshots of log bundles weekly and store them in an encrypted, access-controlled archive with integrity checks.

Operational dependencies / blockers:
- Procurement: formal sign-off for increased storage and escrow costs (estimate attached).
- Subprocessor notice: We will need to inform backup/storage subprocessors of extended retention (we already have an existing subprocessor list; some partners need 30 days lead).

Next steps / timeline (proposal):
1) 10/7 — Redwood sends final cost addendum and updated DPA excerpt language (owner: Kimberly).
2) 10/9 — TerraHealth legal to confirm acceptance of escrow/archive method and special retention language.
3) 10/12 — Ops kickoff to schedule retention policy switch for pilot (owner: Marissa).
4) 10/19 — Verify sample audit-evidence and one replayed restore run for TerraHealth compliance team (owner: Jonas / Karthik).

Attachments: proposed-deletion-flightplan.xlsx (contains schedule, owners, cost breakout).

Jonas Weber
Head of Product Security — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-deletion-flightplan.xlsx (xlsx, 82KB)]
From: legal@terrahealth.com <legal@terrahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention ask for EU pilot — backups and logs

Thanks Jonas — that reads well. Two clarifying questions before we sign the addendum: 

1) Evidence scope: can you produce a redacted sample of the archived log bundle (showing the retention markers, checksums, and access audit trail) prior to 10/19? We need to review the schema and prove non-repudiation.
2) Least-privilege access: we need written confirmation on who will have access to the archived bundles and whether TerraHealth can request a one-off export (and the process/audit log for that export).

Also: can you confirm whether any subprocessor in the chain will perform de-duplication or content scanning on archived bundles — that would be a blocker for us.

Appreciate a short response.

— Legal Ops, TerraHealth

Subject: Re: Retention ask for EU pilot — backups and logs

Anders / Legal team — quick answers and confirmation from procurement/compliance side: 

- Sample evidence: We will provide a redacted archived log bundle sample by 10/15. That bundle will include retention markers (timestamp + TTL metadata), SHA256 checksums, and the access audit trail for any reads. (Owner: Karthik Iyer — Applied ML / infra security will produce.)

- Access / export process: Access will be limited to a named RBAC group (Redwood: "Audit-Access", TerraHealth named contacts will be added on request and logged). Any one-off export requires a signed request and an export ticket; exports are logged and require approval by Ops and Legal. TerraHealth will receive the export manifest and a copy of the read-audit within 48 hours of export.

- Subprocessor behavior: Confirmed — Redwood will not perform content scanning or de-duplication on the archived bundles for the pilot. Storage providers will only perform integrity checks and lifecycle tagging. We will add a clause to the subprocessor notification stating that no scanning/inspection will be applied to archived pilot bundles.

Procurement note: There is a marginal storage / escrow fee for extended snapshots; I'll send the addendum and cost table tomorrow (10/8). Once procurement sign-off is captured we will flip retention gating and schedule the first WORM snapshot on 10/12.

Kimberly Park
Director, Contracts & Compliance — Redwood Inference
